metaTitle: Custom Rectangular Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom rectangular lanyards and badges for your team. Ideal for ID badges, trade shows, and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rectangular lanyards and badges offer a clean, professional shape that fits standard ID card holders and badge reels without excess material. Whether you need durable woven polyester for daily employee use or antimicrobial options for healthcare settings, the rectangular format ensures your logo sits evenly and legibly. Choose from a variety of widths, from slim 3/8" knit styles to sturdy 1" options, and decorate with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation for crisp brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom rectangular lanyards and badges in various colors with printed logos, ideal for ID badges and events.
